metaDescription: Custom fleece jackets and pullovers with your logo. Perfect for corporate gifts, employee rewards, and team uniforms. Order bulk fleece at Perfect
introHtml:
Marketing directors and HR managers know that the right apparel builds team spirit and brand recognition. Custom fleece jackets and pullovers offer warmth, comfort, and a professional look that works for outdoor events, trade shows, and employee appreciation. Whether you need branded fleece for a sales team incentive or logo-printed pullovers for a company retreat, fleece is a versatile choice that keeps your team comfortable and your brand visible.

Our selection includes styles like the Boundary Fleece Jacket, Men's and Ladies' Horizon Fleece Jackets, and the Carhartt Textured 1/2-Zip Fleece Jacket. Choose from quarter-zip, half-zip, and full-zip options in men's and women's cuts. Decorate with screen-printed or embroidered logos to match your brand colors. Bulk ordering keeps unit costs low, making custom fleece an affordable way to outfit your group.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom fleece for your organization, start by considering the use case. For outdoor corporate events or trade shows, a midweight jacket like the Men's Bowlen Polyfleece Qtr Zip provides warmth without bulk. For employee rewards or safety incentives, a durable fleece like the Carhartt Textured 1/2-Zip Fleece Jacket offers long-lasting wear. Safety managers often choose high-visibility colors or add reflective trim for workplace safety programs.

Material quality matters for both comfort and longevity. Polyester fleece is the standard, offering softness, breathability, and easy care. Look for fleece that resists pilling and maintains its shape after washing. The Men's Core 365™ Journey Fleece Jacket uses performance fleece that wicks moisture, making it suitable for active use. For a more polished look, sweater fleece styles like the Men's Villa Sweater Fleece Jacket offer a dressier appearance while retaining warmth.

Decoration Options

Embroidery is the most popular decoration for fleece, providing a professional, durable finish on chests or sleeves. Screen printing works well for large logos or text, but ensure the ink is compatible with fleece fibers to avoid cracking. For small runs or detailed designs, full-color heat transfer offers vibrant results without high setup costs. Always test a sample before placing a large order to confirm color accuracy and placement.

Quantity directly affects pricing. Most bulk fleece orders start at 12 to 24 pieces per style and size run. As order volume increases, per-unit costs drop significantly. For example, ordering 50 to 100 custom fleece jackets often qualifies for tiered discounts. If your team has a wide range of sizes, consider ordering a balanced size run to avoid excess inventory. Work with your account manager to determine the best quantity for your budget and needs.

Common buying mistakes include overlooking sizing differences between brands. Carhartt fleece tends to run larger, while some performance fits are more tailored. Always request a sizing chart and consider ordering a sample of each style you're considering. Lead times typically range from two to four weeks for decorated fleece, so plan ahead for events. Avoid last-minute orders by confirming decoration artwork and approvals early in the process.

For year-end employee gifts or customer appreciation, custom fleece is a practical choice that recipients use for years. Logo fleece reinforces brand loyalty every time it's worn. For trade shows, choose a style with plenty of pocket space for holding business cards or brochures. Wholesale fleece pricing makes it cost-effective to order in bulk, and personalized fleece adds a thoughtful touch that generic gifts lack.

faqs.q: What are the minimum order quantities for custom fleece?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities typically start at 12 to 24 pieces per style and size run. Some styles may have higher minimums for certain decoration methods. Contact your account manager for specific MOQs on the fleece styles you're interested in.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best on fleece?
faqs.a: Embroidery is the most popular and durable option for fleece, offering a professional look on chests or sleeves. Screen printing is also effective but requires special inks to prevent cracking. Full-color heat transfer works well for complex designs with minimal setup costs.

faqs.q: How long does production and shipping take?
faqs.a: Typical lead times for decorated fleece are 2 to 4 weeks, depending on order size and decoration complexity. Rush production may be available for an additional fee. Shipping times vary based on location and carrier.

faqs.q: Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available for most fleece styles. You can order a blank sample to check fit, fabric, and color. For decorated samples, a small setup fee may apply. Samples help ensure you're satisfied before committing to a large order.

faqs.q: What is the best way to care for custom fleece?
faqs.a: Machine wash cold with like colors and tumble dry low to maintain shape and prevent pilling. Avoid bleach and fabric softeners. For embroidered logos, turn the garment inside out before washing to protect the threads.
